north_star.statement: Become a trusted AI engineer who independently builds, evaluates and safely operates useful enterprise AI systems with verified customer outcomes.
north_star.operating_meaning: Independent ownership plus useful held-out quality, enforced safety, real deployment/operations and honest user-outcome evidence—not one inflated composite score.
north_star.first_major_career_outcome: A suitable job switch; applications can begin on verified existing strengths.
north_star.long_term_aspiration: Durable AI/FDE and eventual Staff-level capability where real scope/impact support it; no title or irreplaceability guarantee.

objectives.objective: Make a well-matched job switch through demonstrable interview readiness.
objectives.priority: First major career outcome; applications can use verified existing FE/full-stack strengths now.

key_results.name: Establish an honest target-role and gap baseline
key_results.baseline: not_assessed_or_not_started; no new learning completion inferred
key_results.target: Complete the existing target-role/baseline map and identify role-specific gaps using actual attempts; keep prior SWE evidence distinct from new AI evidence.
required_evidence: Existing baseline/problem brief and role-bank attempt notes; no new reporting stream.
limits: Zero personal-curriculum completion does not erase4+years prior SWE experience; unknown skills remain unknown.

key_results.name: Demonstrate independent performance on relevant interview gates
key_results.baseline: not_assessed_or_not_started; no new learning completion inferred
key_results.target: For each gate relevant to the actual role, pass two different unseen exercises on separate days at least3/4 in critical dimensions, with no critical correctness/security/integrity failure. Use the accepted six-gate rubric; prefer genuine human review.

conditional_learning_window.consolidation: M5.1, roughly Days225–271; not the start of practice

required_evidence: Actual attempt, allowed tools/help, rubric, code/design/story output, feedback and targeted retest.
limits: These are internal readiness criteria, not employer cutoffs. FE/full-stack interviews need the relevant subset; do not wait for all AI gates. Formal20hours accrue across existing bank windows, not an extra final-phase block.

key_results.name: Convert readiness and truthful evidence into a suitable offer/job switch
key_results.baseline: not_assessed_or_not_started; no new learning completion inferred
key_results.target: Track actual interview invitations, stage outcomes, offers and the user’s accepted suitable role; use feedback to repair the relevant gap. A role accepted by the user is the first major outcome, not a guaranteed date.

conditional_learning_window.applications: May begin now on verified existing strengths, as authorized
conditional_learning_window.review: At actual recruiting feedback and scheduled reviews

required_evidence: User-authorized application/interview records and real employer/user decisions.
limits: No application-count quota, invented offer probability, automatic outreach or guaranteed offer. Geography, work authorization, travel, role level and user preferences remain actual filters.

objectives.objective: Independently deliver and explain useful, evaluated, secure AI systems.
objectives.priority: Core engineering evidence; progress in parallel with job switching, without postponing applications.

key_results.name: Build a genuine local generative-RAG system and pass its prototype release gate
key_results.baseline: not_assessed_or_not_started; no new learning completion inferred
key_results.target: Produce real-model, real-embedding and persisted-vector-store receipts, source-grounded generation and failure/abstention behavior; pass the existing narrow held-out prototype criterion and independent ownership check before calling P1 complete.
required_evidence: Existing real inference/retrieval/RAG traces, dev/held-out evaluation, tests, ownership attempt and reproducible demo.
limits: Day30 is not a full P1 pass; U023 is partial. Mock/template output cannot pass real gates. Local output does not imply cloud, production or customer evidence.

key_results.name: Release useful CoverStory behavior on authorized AWS infrastructure
key_results.baseline: not_assessed_or_not_started; no new learning completion inferred
key_results.target: Meet the predeclared workflow quality/abstention/latency criterion on a frozen held-out release; pass server-side access/isolation tests; demonstrate actual AWS-hosted model use and application deploy/redeploy/rollback/teardown.
required_evidence: M2.1 release verdict, M2.2 boundary/CI evidence, M2.3 AWS/provider/operations and usage/cost receipts.
limits: Required gates remain blocked if hardware/access/budget is unavailable; unrelated work continues. AWS alerts are not guaranteed hard cost caps. No paid resources are authorized by this overlay.

key_results.name: Make bounded tools and genuine MCP reliable enough for the scoped workflow
key_results.baseline: not_assessed_or_not_started; no new learning completion inferred
key_results.target: Show actual tool/protocol execution, exact-action approval, denied out-of-scope/unapproved actions, safe failure/handoff and a passed predeclared held-out task-success criterion.
required_evidence: Existing deterministic baseline comparison, MCP client/server trace, approval/boundary tests, held-out task verdict and failure taxonomy.
limits: A trace or one improvement alone is not a pass. No unrestricted terminal or external-write authority; local MCP is not an enterprise OAuth claim.

objectives.objective: Build credible AWS expertise and market-visible proof, not a collection of logos.
objectives.priority: Scheduled AWS credentials and inspectable evidence support interviews; they do not replace coding or delivery.

key_results.name: Diagnose and close the actual AWS certification/practical gaps
key_results.baseline: not_assessed_or_not_started; no new learning completion inferred
key_results.target: Complete C0’s eight30-minute first-month AWS sessions, create the current-syllabus/course gap map, and close relevant gaps with explanation and project-linked practical evidence. Continue two30-minute AWS sessions per7learning days inside the existing bank.
required_evidence: Verified exact purchased course title/code if accessible; otherwise unknown. Existing AWS domain attempts, gap map and authorized project/lab receipts.
limits: Eight attended sessions alone do not prove readiness. C0 is counted once; P2 adds incremental practical work, not a duplicate diagnostic.

key_results.name: Earn the appropriate AWS credential only after demonstrated readiness
key_results.baseline: not_assessed_or_not_started; no new learning completion inferred
key_results.target: For conditional SAA-C03: review all current domains, explain practical tradeoffs, pass two distinct lawful current timed practice assessments against the accepted internal target (proposed80% overall), repair domain gaps and resolve critical security misconceptions; then seek authorized booking. Only an actual pass and issued verification counts as certification.

conditional_learning_window.SAA: No fixed pass date; after readiness and spend authorization
conditional_learning_window.AIP: Later, after real GenAI delivery and target experience/readiness are supported

required_evidence: C2 independent practice/repair evidence; C3 actual vendor result/verification/expiry if earned; later C4 AIP diagnostic.
limits: Internal practice targets are not the vendor passing scale or a guarantee. AIF is optional literacy; MLA only a role-driven AWS ML/MLOps branch. No Azure/Google active tracks, exam purchase or booking is authorized.

key_results.name: Make authentic work easy for a reviewer or employer to inspect
key_results.baseline: not_assessed_or_not_started; no new learning completion inferred
key_results.target: Produce the existing strongest end-to-end case study plus bounded-tools/MCP case with reproducibility, actual results, ownership and limitations; apply substantive reviewer feedback where available. Publish the approved artifact/earned credential only after authorization.

conditional_learning_window.packaging: At genuine milestones; M4.3/M5.3 consolidate existing notes

required_evidence: Existing evidence notes, clean-run result, case-study/demo drafts, actual feedback and approved public link only if published.
limits: No daily-post, follower, star, credential-count or outreach quotas. A private draft is valid; a course certificate is not a vendor credential; audience reach is not a skill score.

objectives.objective: Extend beyond the switch into sustained customer delivery and deep AI/FDE capability.
objectives.priority: Long-term continuation, not a prerequisite for the first offer or a promised Staff title.

key_results.name: Close a real discovery-to-feedback-to-handoff loop where authorized
key_results.baseline: not_assessed_or_not_started; no new learning completion inferred
key_results.target: Define one scoped workflow’s baseline, measurable usefulness/quality/risk criteria and observation window before the pilot; implement feedback, demonstrate recovery/handoff and report actual outcome against the agreed baseline.

conditional_learning_window.actual_customer_outcome: Depends on authorized real-user access and the agreed observation window

required_evidence: Existing discovery/pilot brief, real or explicitly simulated feedback, change/tests, incident/recovery/handoff and outcome evidence.
limits: No invented adoption, savings or customers. Role-play, peer review, real-user pilot, production operation and enterprise impact remain distinct; unavailable real-user evidence remains a gap.

key_results.name: Demonstrate model/data depth rather than only orchestration
key_results.baseline: not_assessed_or_not_started; no new learning completion inferred
key_results.target: Complete the existing learner-built StreamForge/ranking sample with a leakage-safe split, simple baseline, justified held-out metrics, served output and an explained failure; then choose one deeper role-driven branch based on actual gaps.

conditional_learning_window.next_branch: Next60–90learning days after the core, re-estimated at entry

required_evidence: Existing dataset/model manifest, personal implementation/tests, measured comparison, served prediction and branch gap map.
limits: A third full flagship is not required before applying. Do not take every advanced branch or assume paid GPU access; no invented online uplift.

key_results.name: Grow sustained ownership and wider technical influence through actual work
key_results.baseline: not_assessed_or_not_started; no new learning completion inferred
key_results.target: Use real responsibilities to demonstrate reliable operation, stakeholder decisions, reusable engineering improvements and knowledge transfer; select post-training/model-serving/data-platform/distributed-systems depth when the work and evidence justify it.

conditional_learning_window.long_term: Beyond the core and through/beyond the former18-month horizon as useful
conditional_learning_window.review: At role change, completed branch and roughly every90learning days within existing review time

required_evidence: Actual operating/incident/change evidence, stakeholder feedback, reused implementation/standards or genuine OSS review; progressively deeper independent technical demonstrations.
existing_v24_sources: repaired-roadmap-architecture.md: longer-term depth and role tiers
limits: Staff/FDE capability is an aspiration; title, tenure, organizational impact and hiring remain real-world outcomes. No absolute mastery, irreplaceability or guaranteed timetable.

Review frozen evaluation, safety, ownership and relevant live capability evidence; pass, fail or blocked, never calendar completion.

evidence_rules: All new learner progress starts not_started/not_assessed; existing SWE experience is acknowledged separately.
Every pass links to an actual attempt/result and its scope, review date and tool/help allowance.
Leading readiness is distinguishable from lagging hiring/customer/credential outcomes; null means not established, not an invented zero.
Reuse v2.4 evidence artifacts; one artifact may support several KRs but its work/time is counted once.
No external writes, cloud spend, exam booking, outreach or publishing are authorized.
